rateBasis: Set 2026-10-30. Labor $41/billable hr = Las Vegas market wages (BLS OEWS May 2025/2024) for current crew mix (1 lead carpenter, 2 leads in training, 3 laborers), +25.2% burden (FICA 7.65%, FUTA, NV UI ~2.1%, workers comp 10.39% assigned-risk 5645, 5% PTO placeholder), 80% billable. Margins: Remodel 42% and Service 45% cover ~32% overhead (Overhead Tracker, corrected) + ~10% profit; Installer programs 30%.
